content.title: Vinson & Elkins Advises Vital Energy in $3.1 Billion Sale to Crescent Energy
content.summary: By Jarrett Banks Crescent Energy (NYSE: CRGY) will acquire Vital Energy (NYSE: VTLE) in an all-stock deal valued at about $3.1 billion, including debt, law firm Vinson & Elkins said. The companies signed the agreement on Aug. 24 and expect to close the transaction by the end of 2025, pending customary approvals, the firm said. content.title: Nvidia stock rises, Fabrinet upgrade, Vital Energy surges
content.description:
Here are some of the stories Wall Street is watching on Monday, Aug. 25.

Shares of Nvidia (NVDA) are rising ahead of the chip giant's Q2 earnings release on Wednesday, Aug. 27.

JPMorgan upgraded Fabrinet (FN) shares to Overweight from Neutral.

Vital Energy's (VTLE) stock is surging after announcing it was being acquired by Crescent Energy (CRGY).
